name: Elacestrant
mechanism: Orally bioavailable SERD that binds ER, induces its degradation and inhibits ER-dependent transcription, retaining activity against ESR1 ligand-binding domain mutants.
monitoring: Lipid profile before and during treatment
interactions: CYP3A4 substrate; avoid strong/moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors and inducers.
resistance: ESR1-independent mechanisms such as PI3K pathway and cell-cycle alterations.
